gloss: road width; width of a road

definitions.gloss: road width; width of a road or path
definitions.explanation: The horizontal distance from one side of a road or path to the other.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}は{道幅|みちはば}が{狭|せま}い。
{道幅|みちはば}が{広|ひろ}くなって{運転|うんてん}しやすくなった。
examples.english: The road got wider and became easier to drive on.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}のため{道幅|みちはば}が{片側|かたがわ}だけに{制限|せいげん}されている。
examples.english: Due to construction, the road width has been restricted to one side only.

notes:
A compound of {道|みち} (road, path) and {幅|はば} (width). A straightforward and commonly used word in everyday Japanese.

USAGE:
Often appears in driving contexts, traffic reports, and descriptions of streets. Many Japanese residential streets are very narrow, so {道幅|みちはば} is a practical concern for drivers. Also used in urban planning and real estate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道幅|みちはば}が{狭|せま}い — the road is narrow
- {道幅|みちはば}が{広|ひろ}い — the road is wide
- {道幅|みちはば}を{広|ひろ}げる — to widen the road
- {道幅|みちはば}{制限|せいげん} — road width restriction

RELATED TERMS:
- {車道|しゃどう} — roadway; the part of the road for vehicles
- {歩道|ほどう} — sidewalk; the pedestrian part
- {幅員|ふくいん} — road width; the technical/legal term
